description: The dream dictionary's entry for one symbol: what it means in a dream, the countries where it's the standout or most common symbol in real dreams, a few shared dreams about it, and the link to its page. When there's no entry by that name, the closest symbol names are returned instead.

symbol.description: The symbol, as a word or short phrase in English: "snake", "teeth falling out", "ex". Singular works best.

name: lookup_dream_symbol
title: Look up a dream symbol
